# netbox_ipam_role (Data Source)

Retrieves a single ipam role from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_ipam_role" "example" {
  name = "Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the ipam role.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A description of the ipam role.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the ipam role.
- `weight` (Number) The weight of the ipam role.
